question.worked_solution:
The angle addition postulate gives:

$$
\begin{aligned}m∠EOD & =m∠EOB+m∠BOD \\  & ={82}^{∘}+{47}^{∘} \\  & ={129}^{∘}\end{aligned}
$$

From the diagram, $∠AOF$ and $∠EOD$ are vertical angles. Since vertical angles are congruent, we have 

$$
m∠AOF=m∠EOD={129}^{∘}.
$$

On the other hand, since $∠AOC$ is a right angle, the angle addition postulate gives:

$$
\begin{aligned}m∠AOF & =m∠AOC+m∠COF \\ {129}^{∘} & ={90}^{∘}+m∠COF \\ m∠COF & ={39}^{∘}\end{aligned}
$$
